text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy with secondary Sepsis. The clinical picture of a 31-weeker with chorioamnionitis, poor Apgars, lethargy, seizures, and specifically a tense anterior fontanelle suggests sepsis with intraventricular hemorrhage or severe metabolic derangement; pneumonia is a possible co-morbidity but less likely the primary cause of the fontanelle findings.
